name: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
summary: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk, through its various subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in the extraction of precious metals like gold and silver, as well as coal mining. The company's business activities extend beyond mining to include the trading of fuels and different types of metals. Additionally, it provides freight-related services. Established in 2008, the Indonesian firm is based in Jakarta, where its headquarters are located.
